_comment: Gold question/citation pairs for engine/eval_harness.js, hand-written against the 6 already-structured pilot sections (product_roadmap.md §3 M1). Every 'expect_answered: true' case was run against the live query_router and its actual citation/id verified before being added here — this file records real, checked behavior, not aspirational answers. Extend as coverage grows (M3); do not hand-edit expected citations without re-running against the real data.
